Live Google, Apple and Turnkey integrations are unverified: suites use test RSA keys, an in-process provider stand-in and the MOCKED loopback harness (e2e/account-harness.ts). They certify FloFi's verification, isolation and authorization rules, not the providers.
Turnkey activity versions and result shapes come from @turnkey/http 6.7.0 declarations; confirm on a Turnkey test organization before enabling production.

Managed wallets cannot sign FloFi transactions in this build (no signing adapter; disclosed in the product and a release blocker); Build/Simulate/Execute regressions are covered by the existing suites, not by this module.

Email sign-up uses Turnkey's legacy OTP activities, which CREATE_SUB_ORGANIZATION_V8 does not accept per Turnkey's migration guide; the encrypted OTP flow (@turnkey/crypto) is a release blocker pending an owner dependency decision.
